title: Loop variable 'dev' shadows the 'dev' function parameter at line 416
detail: In `_free_device(self, dev, ...)`, the for-loop `for dev in freed_devs:` at line 416 redefines the `dev` parameter. After the else-branch executes, `dev` holds the last element of `freed_devs`, not the original device. Any code added after this block that expects `dev` to be the original argument would silently get the wrong object. Rename the loop variable (e.g., `for freed_dev in freed_devs:`).

title: 3 methods have unused 'context' parameter (interface contract)
detail: Methods at lines 312, 420, and 436 declare a `context` parameter that is never used. These follow the oslo convention of always accepting a request context. Prefix the unused parameter with `_` to signal that it is part of the interface but intentionally unused.
